collection.title: Citroen C4 Coupe 2004 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Citroen C4 Coupe 2004 to 2010 model which requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 24" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Citroen C4 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
